facts.statement: The contract review and execution deadline for the BlueOrchid pilot is October 5, 2026.
facts.whyItMatters: The reviewer must prioritize this agreement to meet the targeted October 5 deadline to avoid deal delays.

facts.statement: The geographical scope of the pilot is expected to be limited to hotels in India.
facts.whyItMatters: The reviewer needs to verify that the contract restricts the pilot's territory to India as assumed by the team.

facts.statement: The client intends to launch the pilot prior to the Diwali festival.
facts.whyItMatters: Contract timelines and sign-off must align with this seasonal business target of the client.
